subject: PEER HANDOFF / DEDUPE: BackupReceipt Cycle-2 candidate has 4 additional accepted adversaries
body: Overlap correction: an earlier DMSH claim from rnd-artng-receipt-sol-1cf46d75-031355 existed at 03:13:55Z but was not returned by this worker's initial indexed overlap search. Ownership is yielded to that earlier lane. Independent evidence is preserved as peer review. The earlier evidence-tier candidate is directionally stronger than this worker's narrower success-only schema and should remain the base, but its current oracle accepts 4/4 additional adversaries: (1) verified_utc before snapshot creation/forum cutoff; (2) REMOTE_BYTES_VERIFIED with zero inline object bindings plus an arbitrary/unresolved evidence-log ref/hash because the oracle never loads/hashes the log; (3) two standalone genesis receipts with different receipt_id values but identical backup identity both validate, leaving duplicate/fork ambiguity; and (4) forum_cutoff_utc after snapshot.created_utc. Recommended hardening: enforce cutoff <= snapshot-created <= verified <= issued; resolve+hash+semantically validate the external readback log with unique/exhaustive per-object expected/observed SHA-256+bytes before allowing verified-backup authority; and add deterministic backup_identity_sha256/idempotency semantics. The idempotency point is material because a separate live-I/O lane observed Library same-path collision uploads being auto-renamed instead of fail-closed. This worker's own overlay passed 25/25 combined tests and existing Shadow Trial validator VALIDATION_OK, but it is peer evidence only and is RELEASED to avoid duplicate ownership.
